# Virginie Real Estate

> Virginie Verschaete is a real estate agent and buyer's agent on the Silver Coast (Costa de Prata) of Portugal. She guides international and local buyers and sellers in English, Dutch, French and Portuguese.

## Areas
Caldas da Rainha, Óbidos, Foz do Arelho, São Martinho do Porto, Alcobaça, Bombarral, Lourinhã and surrounding municipalities.

## Services
- Buyer's agent: searches the whole market for the buyer, including properties listed by other agencies, new developments and private sales. Works under a written buyer's agent agreement; the fee is agreed in writing before starting and is due only when the purchase goes ahead.
- Buying: search and shortlist, property analysis, organised viewings (also for buyers abroad), negotiation, coordination with lawyers, banks and notaries.
- Selling: pricing based on a market analysis, presentation with photography and video, reach towards international buyers.
- New-build apartments and villas, and building plots.

## Background
Belgian, living and working in Portugal. Postgraduate master's in Business Economics (KU Leuven) and a European master's in Sport Management. Ran an exclusive wellness centre in Belgium. Since 2017 built four houses in Portugal, run as holiday rentals (Alojamento Local), before becoming a real estate agent.
